content_md: Yes I agree with this 100%, I've kind of been hammering on this point for a decade. Except it's slightly worse, they actually have an anti-theory of goals (the [orthogonality thesis](https://ammdi.hyperphor.com/orthogonality-thesis)) which ensures they will never have a decent theory of goal-directed behavior.
